dependencies.summary: Projects are mostly independent with one strong integration opportunity. All three CAN run in parallel, but sequencing LanceDB before MCP yields a better MCP server.

mcp_server_depends_on.lancedb: soft — MCP server can launch with TF-IDF/FTS5 backend first, then add LanceDB as a second search tool once available. Not a blocker.
mcp_server_depends_on.rate_limiter_fix: none — MCP server is a new module, does not touch coordination code.

lancedb_depends_on.mcp_server: none — LanceDB is a backend concern, MCP is a serving concern. Fully independent.
lancedb_depends_on.rate_limiter_fix: none — LanceDB indexes knowledge-base content, not coordination state.

rate_limiter_fix_depends_on.lancedb: none — operates on different SQLite databases entirely.

dependencies.optimal_sequencing: Start all three in parallel. If resources are constrained: rate limiter fix first (smallest scope, removes tech debt), then LanceDB (creates semantic search capability), then MCP server (exposes both FTS5 and LanceDB via universal protocol).
dependencies.critical_path: LanceDB -> MCP integration is the only meaningful dependency edge. MCP can ship v1 without it.

mcp_server.blast_radius: minimal — new standalone module, no changes to existing code

risks.risk: Scope creep — temptation to expose coordination bus, work stealing, help protocol etc. via MCP
risks.mitigation: Hard scope: KB search only. No coordination tools in v1.

risks.risk: FastMCP version compatibility — SDK is evolving rapidly (97M+ downloads means fast iteration)
risks.mitigation: Pin FastMCP version. The core @mcp.tool() decorator API is stable.

risks.risk: Testing difficulty — MCP servers are typically tested via integration, not unit tests
risks.mitigation: Use FastMCP's built-in test client. Keep tool functions pure and testable independently.

lancedb.blast_radius: moderate — introduces first external dependency (lancedb pip package), adds embedding generation step

risks.risk: Embedding model selection — need to choose an embedding model (local vs API-based)
risks.mitigation: Use sentence-transformers with a small local model (all-MiniLM-L6-v2) to avoid API dependency. LanceDB supports this natively.

risks.risk: Index staleness — KB entries change; vector index must stay in sync
risks.mitigation: Build a simple rebuild-index script. With 38 KB entries, full reindex takes seconds.

risks.risk: Dependency weight — lancedb + pyarrow + sentence-transformers could be 500MB+
risks.mitigation: Document install requirements. Consider making it optional (graceful fallback to FTS5-only).

risks.risk: Yak-shaving into RAG architecture — KB-0034 mentions GraphRAG, LightRAG, Agentic RAG, hybrid retrieval
risks.mitigation: HARD STOP at basic semantic search. No graph construction, no agentic retrieval, no re-ranking. Pure vector similarity + optional FTS5 hybrid.

rate_limiter_fix.blast_radius: high — modifying live coordination code used by all agents. Regression could break multi-agent operations.

risks.risk: Regression in multi-agent coordination — fix introduces new bug in hot path
risks.mitigation: Existing stress tests cover these paths. Run full test suite before and after. Write targeted regression tests for each TOCTOU fix.

risks.risk: Scope expansion — bug report lists 32 bugs (2 high, 15 medium, 15 low). Temptation to fix them all.
risks.mitigation: Scope to exactly the 2 high-severity TOCTOU bugs: BUG-HELP-001 (fulfill_help) and BUG-WS-001 (complete_work). Medium bugs are fix-later.

risks.risk: Incomplete fix — wrapping in BEGIN IMMEDIATE without handling all edge cases
risks.mitigation: Each fix should include: (1) BEGIN IMMEDIATE wrapping, (2) proper ROLLBACK on failure, (3) stress test proving the race is closed.

risks.risk: SQLite locking contention increase — BEGIN IMMEDIATE acquires a write lock earlier, potentially increasing contention
risks.mitigation: These are short transactions (SELECT + UPDATE). Lock hold time is microseconds. Existing busy_timeout handles contention.

mcp_server.rationale: KB-0034 says under 50 lines with FastMCP. Existing kb_search.py provides the search logic. This is primarily a wrapping exercise: expose existing functions as MCP tools.
key_tasks: Create mcp_kb_server.py with @mcp.tool() decorators wrapping kb_search.py functions
Test with MCP inspector or FastMCP test client
Document usage in CLAUDE.md or storage/scripts/index.json

lancedb.rationale: Requires embedding model selection, index creation script, search API, and integration with existing search. First external dependency introduces packaging concerns.
key_tasks: Write indexer script to vectorize all KB entries, team logs, scripts metadata
Create search API module with semantic_search(query, top_k) function
Build hybrid search combining FTS5 scores with vector similarity
Write reindex script for keeping vectors current
Add graceful fallback when lancedb not installed

rate_limiter_fix.rationale: The fixes themselves are small (wrapping operations in BEGIN IMMEDIATE), but the testing burden is high. Must prove race conditions are closed without introducing regressions across 2573 lines of coordination code.
key_tasks: Fix BUG-HELP-001: wrap fulfill_help SELECT + 2x UPDATE in BEGIN IMMEDIATE with ROLLBACK
Fix BUG-WS-001: wrap complete_work SELECT + UPDATE in BEGIN IMMEDIATE or add WHERE clause for optimistic locking
Write targeted stress tests proving each race is closed
Run existing stress test suite to check for regressions
Optionally fix BUG-DC-003 (join/leave_channel TOCTOU) if time permits

integration_plan.vision: MCP server serves as the universal access layer; LanceDB provides semantic search backend; rate limiter fixes ensure the coordination layer these tools rely on is sound.

integrations.integration: MCP server exposes a semantic_search tool backed by LanceDB, alongside the existing FTS5-based keyword search tool. Users get both search modalities through one MCP interface.
integrations.implementation: MCP server imports from both kb_search.py (keyword) and new lancedb_search.py (semantic). Two separate @mcp.tool() endpoints.
integrations.priority: high — this is the primary value combination

integrations.integration: No direct integration. However, if MCP server later exposes coordination tools (v2+), the rate limiter fixes ensure those tools are safe.
integrations.priority: low — only relevant for future MCP coordination tools

integrations.integration: No integration. They operate on completely separate data stores and code paths.

architecture.layer_3_serving: mcp_kb_server.py exposes search tools via MCP protocol

anti_patterns.source: KB-0035, KB-0030, empirical data from 30+ team sessions

patterns_to_avoid.name: Infrastructure Gravity
patterns_to_avoid.description: KB-0035 identifies 7 consecutive infrastructure teams with 0 domain output. These 3 projects are ALL infrastructure.
patterns_to_avoid.mitigation: Time-box all three projects aggressively. Each should be 'done enough' in one session. Do NOT iterate on infrastructure in subsequent sessions. The next session after this MUST produce domain output (market research picks).
trigger_signs: 'Let me also refactor...', 'While I'm here, I should also...', 'This would be even better if...'

patterns_to_avoid.name: Scope Creep via Adjacent Discovery
patterns_to_avoid.description: The bug report lists 32 bugs. LanceDB research mentions 6 RAG architectures. MCP could expose 14+ coordination endpoints. Each project has a 'galaxy brain' expansion path.
patterns_to_avoid.mitigation: Define DONE criteria before starting: MCP = serves 2-3 KB search tools and responds to queries. LanceDB = indexes KB entries and returns ranked results. Rate limiter = BUG-HELP-001 and BUG-WS-001 fixed with tests passing.
trigger_signs: Discussing GraphRAG or LightRAG during LanceDB work
Adding coordination tools to MCP server
Fixing medium-severity bugs during TOCTOU sprint

patterns_to_avoid.name: Anti-Recursion Violation (SOP-023)
patterns_to_avoid.description: Building tools to search our own tools. KB-0030 warns about 7 inward-facing sessions. These projects are useful ONLY if they enable domain output in future sessions.
patterns_to_avoid.mitigation: Frame each project by its domain enablement: MCP server = future agents can search KB without file system access. LanceDB = 'what do we know about X?' becomes answerable semantically. Rate limiter = coordination doesn't corrupt during actual research operations.
trigger_signs: Building a tool to manage the tools we built to manage our tools

patterns_to_avoid.name: Premature Generalization
patterns_to_avoid.description: Making LanceDB index 'everything' (all repo data, all bus messages, all SOPs) when 38 KB entries is the actual corpus.
patterns_to_avoid.mitigation: Index KB entries only in v1. Team logs and scripts are stretch goals. Bus messages and coordination state should NEVER be indexed.
trigger_signs: Adding configurable data sources before the first source works

patterns_to_avoid.name: Test Theater
patterns_to_avoid.description: Writing elaborate test infrastructure for the TOCTOU fixes instead of focused regression tests that prove the specific race is closed.
patterns_to_avoid.mitigation: Each TOCTOU fix needs exactly one stress test: spawn N threads, all trying the racy operation simultaneously, assert no data corruption. Reuse existing stress test patterns.
trigger_signs: More test code than fix code by 10x+

roles: tester (writes stress tests, runs regression suite)
allocation.rationale: Smallest scope but highest blast radius. Two agents provide review/test coverage. One agent could do it but the testing burden justifies a pair.

roles: searcher (builds search API and hybrid ranking)
allocation.rationale: Medium complexity with clear separation between indexing and querying. Two agents can parallelize these concerns.

allocation.project: Build MCP Server for KB Search
roles: builder (creates MCP server wrapping existing search)
allocation.rationale: Lowest complexity (under 50 lines core). Solo agent is most efficient for small, well-defined tasks (KB-0035: 4.0 artifacts/agent solo vs 0.44 at scale).

roles: integrator (connects LanceDB backend to MCP server once both are ready, validates end-to-end)
allocation.rationale: This agent starts as think-tank strategist, then pivots to integration work in the second half of the session.

roles: strategist (this agent — monitors progress, catches scope creep, ensures DONE criteria are met)
allocation.rationale: KB-0035 shows think tank convergence produces unique cross-cutting insights. Also serves as anti-recursion watchdog per SOP-023.

phase_1_parallel_start.description: All three projects kick off simultaneously
phase_1_parallel_start.mcp: Solo agent creates mcp_kb_server.py wrapping kb_search.py with 2-3 @mcp.tool() endpoints
phase_1_parallel_start.lancedb: Pair starts with embedding model selection and index script
phase_1_parallel_start.toctou: Pair starts with BUG-HELP-001 fix (higher severity, fulfill_help transaction wrapping)

phase_2_parallel_continue.description: Each project reaches its DONE criteria independently
phase_2_parallel_continue.mcp: Solo agent tests MCP server, adds to storage/scripts/index.json
phase_2_parallel_continue.lancedb: Pair builds search API and validates with representative queries
phase_2_parallel_continue.toctou: Pair fixes BUG-WS-001, runs full stress test suite

phase_3_integration.description: Integrator agent connects LanceDB to MCP server
actions: Add semantic_search @mcp.tool() to MCP server backed by LanceDB
Test hybrid search (keyword + semantic) through MCP interface
Verify rate limiter fixes pass all existing tests

phase_4_documentation.description: All agents converge on session artifacts
actions: Write KB entries for each project (KB-0039, KB-0040, KB-0041)
Update CLAUDE.md with MCP server usage
Think tank produces final convergence report

done_criteria.mcp_server: MCP server responds to search queries via MCP protocol. Minimum 2 tools: search_kb(query) and get_entry(id). Tested with at least 3 queries.
done_criteria.lancedb: All 38 KB entries indexed with embeddings. semantic_search(query, top_k) returns relevant results. Tested with 5+ queries showing semantic understanding beyond keyword matching.
done_criteria.toctou_fix: BUG-HELP-001 and BUG-WS-001 fixed. Each fix wrapped in BEGIN IMMEDIATE with proper ROLLBACK. At least 1 stress test per fix proving the race is closed. Full existing test suite passes.
done_criteria.integration: MCP server has both keyword and semantic search tools. End-to-end test: query MCP -> get semantically relevant KB entries.

session_time_budget.rule: If any project is not converging by 60% of session time, descope it to its minimum viable version rather than allowing it to consume remaining time.

descope_plan.mcp: Ship with just search_kb tool wrapping existing TF-IDF search. No semantic search integration.
descope_plan.lancedb: Ship indexer script only. Search API deferred to next session.
descope_plan.toctou: Ship BUG-HELP-001 fix only. BUG-WS-001 deferred.

execution_recommendation.next_session_mandate: Per KB-0035 and SOP-023: the session AFTER this one MUST be domain work (market research picks). These 3 infrastructure projects are the LAST infrastructure work before forced domain output.
